claims.title: Absolute risk claim needs substantiation
claims.fix: Describe the actual risks, using wording approved by your compliance team

claims.title: Guaranteed return language is high risk
claims.fix: Remove the guarantee, or state the exact contractual terms if one exists

claims.title: Performance comparison claim needs substantiation
claims.fix: State the benchmark, period and verified results, or remove the claim

disclaimers.title: Missing Forward-Looking Statements Disclaimer
disclaimers.fix: Add a forward-looking statements disclaimer, using wording approved by your legal or compliance team.

disclaimers.title: Missing Past Performance Disclaimer
disclaimers.fix: Add a past performance disclaimer, using wording approved by your legal or compliance team.
